newsitem.title: USA: Wellcare says premiums expected to rise.
newsitem.headline: Wellcare says premiums expected to rise.

text.p: Wellcare Management Group Inc said Thursday it expects its premiums to rise modestly in all lines of business.

The company also said it is on target of reaching its goal of operational profitability by the end of the year, excluding extraordinary legal and accounting expenses associated with ongoing litigation.
In addition, the company said it expects to recapture its basic "operational earnings power" for the first half of 1998.
The company said it is rapidly expanding its marketing and sales efforts, and it expects membership gains throughout the remainder of 1997.
It said it expects aggregate SG&A expenses, excluding extraordinary legal and accounting costs associated with ongoing litigation, to continue to moderate.
WellCare Management is the parent company of WellCare of New York and WellCare of Connecticut.
